subject.title: BL-ecommerce-coupons: static promo banner hardcodes 5% discount copy

question: Should the ecommerce promo banner derive active offer copy from coupon data, from a dedicated editable promotion/CMS config, or remain localized static copy while only removing the unused legacy banner?
rationale: The code can support coupon metadata, but marketing copy, locale behavior, scheduling, and ownership of live promotions are product decisions that automation should not choose implicitly.

options.title: Use a promotion source of truth
options.body: Create or select an editable promo config/API that references the coupon and exposes localized copy plus structured discount terms to the header strip.

options.title: Derive directly from coupon documents
options.body: Generate the banner from the active coupon’s `discount.kind` and locale-specific coupon mapping, reducing config duplication but limiting marketing phrasing flexibility.

options.title: Keep static copy and remove legacy banner
options.body: Remove or deprecate `CouponBanner` to eliminate the dead `5%` constant, accepting that the visible `PromoStrip` remains manually synchronized.

recommendation.title: Use a promotion source of truth
recommendation.body: Create or select an editable promo config/API that references the coupon and exposes localized copy plus structured discount terms to the header strip.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the named Coupons & Promotions owner in the related BL block and is the best routing point for promo behavior and source-of-truth decisions.
